name: Particles
description: WebGL2 field of drifting, softly glowing particles in 3D that slowly rotates and reacts to the pointer, with optional connection lines, click shockwaves and depth of field.
contents: Container div with a single full-size aria-hidden WebGL2 canvas
Instanced particles in four shapes, optional lines between nearby particles
behavior: Particle cloud slowly rotates and each particle bobs; sizes twinkle
Pointer hover applies parallax, repel or attract depending on hoverEffect
Click or tap emits a shockwave burst (up to 4 at once)
Optional intro reveal, vertical or forward drift, and connection lines between close particles
Rendering pauses when offscreen, tab hidden or paused is true
Respects prefers-reduced-motion by skipping intro and click bursts
editableByProps: Particle count, spread, size, colors, shape, glow, twinkle, opacity and depth of field
Rotation, speed, drift direction and camera distance
Hover effect and radius, click bursts, connection lines, intro and pause
Dark or light background adaptation through lightMode, and layout through className and style

needsCodeEdit.change: Raise or lower the maximum particle, line or burst limits
needsCodeEdit.where: MAX_COUNT, MAX_LINKED, MAX_LINES and MAX_BURSTS constants at the top of the file

needsCodeEdit.change: Change intro or shockwave timing and speed
needsCodeEdit.where: INTRO_SECONDS, BURST_SECONDS, BURST_SPEED and BURST_WIDTH constants

needsCodeEdit.change: Add a new particle shape or hover effect
needsCodeEdit.where: SHAPES and EFFECTS maps and the fragment and vertex shader strings

needsCodeEdit.change: Limit pointer tracking to the container instead of the whole window
needsCodeEdit.where: window pointer event listeners in the first useEffect

fixed: Requires WebGL2; if unavailable nothing is drawn
Parent must have a defined height because the container is h-full w-full
Listens to pointer events on the whole window and document, not only the container
Particle count capped at 20000, at most 4 simultaneous click bursts
Canvas is aria-hidden and decorative only
Uses Tailwind utility classes for container and canvas layout
Colors are re-parsed through a 2D canvas, so any CSS color string works
Particle layout is seeded and changes only with count, variation, colors or lightMode
Heavy settings (high counts with connections) can be costly on small or low-power devices
